title: BitClub Network Update - Amazing passive income growth
description: My six month update to BitClub Network. So far i have see a fantastic return in excess of 6% per month! Amazing passive income ...

asr.full_text: Hello This is Andy Green from Passive Income Wiz just giving you a little 6 month update on my experiences with Bitclub Network so far 6 months ago I invested in the founder pack as you can see here three and a half thousand dollars I'd been following this through some people I know before that and I decided to invest and so far I'm extremely glad that I have so as you can see from up here the mining earnings in terms of the return so far is just under three bitcoins that's just just under fifteen hundred dollars so in six months I've probably got about thirty six, thirty seven percent of my investment money back or even though I can't withdraw any of that, because I'm re-investing all of my mining cash back into getting more shares, because these shares will last when I bought them now days now the share lasts 600 days. So if I just take you to where my mining shares are, you can see here all of the automatic repurchases that are done on each of these pools. So the mining pool 1, the $500 mine this is a thousand dollar pool to the $2 dollar mine. This is the $1000 dollar pool, this is the $2000 dollar pool. You can see I'm now up to just under, about one and two thirds shares here. One and a half here, about one point four there. And you can see that all of these I got set up here, on one hundred percent repurchase. I could if I wanted to, reduce this down to a minimum of 50% repurchase, this one down to 40, this one down to 30, but I'm gonna keep, I've decided I'm going to keep mine all on a 100% until certainly all of the shares double in size, and you can see here I still got 826 days to run on the initial share. Now, even though those are now been reduced to 600 days, that's more than enough time to double up and start getting sort of ongoing constant growth from your initial investments. It's not like you buy them for now 600 days and then they disappear after that and you've got nothing left. So this is why you're obliged to make certain amounts of repurchasing as the minimum. So up here as well as that you can see Clubcoin. So Clubcoin is a free currency is a Bitclub Network's own currency and they've launched recently. It's fluctuating their value quite a lot but this is free money I actually had about just over five thousand of these Clubcoin and I actually sold half of them to buy into another mine. I'll show you in a moment. And this is some other bitcoin I've got from other transactions and this is money sitting my account has come to me via bitclub network as well. So if I look into here, we can see my Ethereum mine. So I know it's very confusing and i need to do some more posts explaining the various differences on these but the etherium is another form of currency and another uh different similar to bitcoin itself. These are all on automatic purchases you can't re-purchase this they, this sold out in about 24 hours, so far I haven't been in it for not very long at all, I could sell these today and get 142, just over 143, nearly, dollars. But the value of the Ethereum may well continue to grow quite a lot. So if that doubles or triples in value, then obviously this would double or triple in value immediately. So I'm gonna hang onto that. So, so so so far I've been in for about six months you can go in and have a look at the website here it's free to join to actually investigate more of the information on the website if you then wanted to invest in one of these mining pools or more or the founder pack like I did then you do need to pay a one-off $99 membership fee to do that. And then you go ahead and buy the access to the mining pools. As I said, so far I've seen a growth of over in excess of 6% per month in the six months I've done things so far and you don't have to I didn't I wouldn't have needed other than through interest to have logged in at all in that time I still would have seen exactly the same growth. So this is a fantastic resource really enjoying it you can withdraw the money else and when you want if you are actually setting this up to fall into the wallet as opposed to repurchasing. And i'd encourage you all to have a look at this, it's great stuff. Any questions you may have, please let me know and i'd be very happy to help out. All right take care And this is Andy Green from Passive Income with signing off, Bye! http://passiveincome.com

textual.observation: Speaker claims BitClub Network produced more than 6% monthly growth/return and links that claim to looking at the website and investing in mining pools or a founder pack with a $99 membership fee.

evidence.quote: fantastic return in excess of 6% per month!
you can go in and have a look at the website here it's free to join to actually investigate more of the information on the website
if you then wanted to invest in one of these mining pools or more or the founder pack like I did then you do need to pay a one-off $99 membership fee to do that
so far I've seen a growth of over in excess of 6% per month

textual.context: The source frames this as a first-person six-month update and includes encouragement to look at the opportunity; promotion versus personal discussion is supported but exact commercial relationship is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: A specific monthly return/growth claim is tied to a requested website visit and optional paid investment path, including a stated membership fee and mining-pool purchase.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish actual returns, website contents, payments, mining activity, viewer outcomes, or the speaker's relationship to BitClub Network.

textual.observation: Speaker describes a $3,500 founder-pack investment, mining shares, and repurchase requirements/settings connected to ongoing growth and reinvestment rather than withdrawal.

evidence.quote: 6 months ago I invested in the founder pack as you can see here three and a half thousand dollars
I can't withdraw any of that, because I'm re-investing all of my mining cash back into getting more shares
you're obliged to make certain amounts of repurchasing as the minimum
more than enough time to double up and start getting sort of ongoing constant growth from your initial investments

textual.context: The speaker presents this as their own settings and experience; the record mentions both automatic repurchases and minimum repurchase obligations.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed investment-growth mechanism is linked to an upfront purchase and ongoing repurchase conditions, with withdrawal affected by reinvestment choices described in the source.
textual.limitations: The exact platform rules, enforceability of repurchase minimums, availability of withdrawals, and current status of any funds are not established by these records.

textual.potential_relevance: A claimed free platform currency is described as having value and being usable in a transaction to buy into another mining opportunity.
textual.limitations: The source does not verify Clubcoin's market value, liquidity, how the coins were obtained, or whether the described sale occurred.

textual.observation: Speaker describes an Ethereum mine position as sold out quickly, currently sellable for about $143, and potentially doubling or tripling if Ethereum value rises.

I could sell these today and get 142, just over 143, nearly, dollars
if that doubles or triples in value, then obviously this would double or triple in value immediately

textual.context: The statement is speculative and tied to the speaker's current holding; the source does not show a direct instruction to buy that specific sold-out mine.
textual.potential_relevance: A potential double-or-triple value claim is linked to a mining asset and a scarcity condition that it sold out in about 24 hours.
textual.limitations: The record does not establish future Ethereum price movement, actual sale value, mine availability, or whether viewers could participate.

visual.observation: A Bitcoin Club webpage displays mining-pool options priced at $500, $1,000, $2,000, and $3,500, each with a visible “Buy Now” button. Nearby text states that purchasing a percentage of Bitcoin mined will result in commission payments and that part of the payout is used to purchase additional shares and equipment.
visual.context: Presented as content within a Bitcoin Club mining-pool account webpage; the sampled frames do not show narration or clarify whether this is an advertisement, demonstration, or account activity.
visual.potential_relevance: The page links paying to buy mining-pool shares with promised or described Bitcoin-based commission payments, creating a payment-to-return relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot establish whether mining occurred, whether any payout was made, or whether the displayed prices and claims were genuine.

visual.observation: An “Ethereum Mining Pool” page shows an “ETH Payment Address” section with a field to enter an Ethereum address and a “Save Address” button. The accompanying text says that shares are paid weekly in Ether mined by the pool and instructs the user to set up an Ethereum wallet and save the Ethereum address.
visual.context: The instruction and payment claim appear together in an Ethereum mining-pool account interface.
visual.potential_relevance: A requested cryptocurrency-wallet address is directly connected on the page to the promised or described receipt of weekly Ether payouts.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show whether an address was submitted, whether funds were transferred, or whether the payout arrangement operated as described.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub Network as a passive-income opportunity by reporting returns above 6% per month and directing viewers toward paid mining-pool or founder-pack participation. It describes a $3,500 founder-pack investment, additional share purchases funded by mining proceeds, minimum repurchasing requirements, and paid mining options with Buy Now controls. The Ethereum discussion includes a conditional doubling-or-tripling value claim and a wallet-address entry connected to the mining-pool account, although the evidence does not establish actual mining, payouts, withdrawals, or viewer losses.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links purchased founder-pack and mining-pool participation to reported mining earnings and monthly growth. The visible pool offers provide a purchase pathway; the reported results remain unverified.
